profile.summary: Olectra Greentech Limited manufactures and sells electric buses and trucks in India. It operates in two segments, Energy Division and Mobility Division. The company offers electric tippers. It also provides 1200KV, 330-420KV, 220-245KV, 110-132KV, 52-77KV, 33-36KV, 22-28KV, and 10-15KV composite polymer insulators for transmission and distribution; and tonne, bracket tube, and stay arm insulators
